cases.name: Airbnb: Applying Deep Learning to Airbnb Search
cases.takeaway: Moving from gradient boosted trees to neural rankers; most gains came from features, data and evaluation discipline, not architecture.

cases.name: Google: BERT for understanding search queries
cases.takeaway: A transformer reads the query in context (prepositions like 'to' and 'for' matter), applied first to a share of English queries.

cases.name: Amazon: Semantic Product Search
cases.takeaway: A two-tower model trained on purchase data retrieves products that lexical matching misses; combined with lexical retrieval.

cases.name: Spotify: natural language search for podcast episodes
cases.takeaway: Dense retrieval with a fine-tuned multilingual encoder, served with ANN alongside the existing lexical search.

cases.name: Bing: LLMs as relevance judges
cases.takeaway: Carefully prompted LLM labels matched searcher preferences about as well as human raters and were used at scale.
